Class PostReplyValidatorTest

java.lang.Object
tests.PostReplyValidatorTest
class PostReplyValidatorTest extends Object

Title: PostReplyValidatorTest

Description: Tests for PostReplyValidator covering:

  • TD-01 group: checkThreadPermission — CWE 4 (Missing Authorization): non-staff callers must be blocked; staff callers must be allowed.
  • TD-02 group: checkForValidThreadName — thread name must be non-null, non-blank, and at most MAX_THREAD_NAME_LENGTH characters.
  • TD-03 group: checkForValidThreadDescription — description is optional (null/blank allowed) but must not exceed MAX_THREAD_DESC_LENGTH characters.

All methods return "" on success and a non-empty error string on failure.
